notes.grounding: Parser lines 544-562, the flat final exit 0, the Overall Completion line, the --file Completion line, the 0/1 exit-code comment block, the clamp near 294-299, bc and the vitest file and config all match the real script. Only T011 (vitest command) and T012 (validate.sh, RESULT: PASSED) name a command plus the passing output. The plan's testing strategy is strong but is not attached to tasks.
